Fire-fighting appliance; treating life-safety equipment as generic obstacle violates life-safety semantics.

track_c_exit_sign_calibration.size_stratification_finding: 33.4% of exit signs are small (area < 0.01). Truncated by monolithic 0.15 threshold; restored via class-calibrated operating point.

next_phase_recommendation: Phase 8.8 controlled training experiment utilizing the Phase 8.7 prepared dataset and evaluating class-calibrated loss/thresholding.
